caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of fabric or lace on a beige background. The fabric is decorated with a repeating pattern of white floral and botanical motifs, including various flowers, leaves, and stems. The design is intricate and features both curved and straight stems, with clusters of small blossoms and patterned leaves distributed throughout. The border is defined by a wavy line with small, regularly spaced floral elements along the edge. The inner area of the square contains a lighter mesh or net-like fill, with the white botanical elements densely arranged but not uniformly distributed, giving a sense of organic composition. In the lower-left corner of the beige area outside the lace design, there are some faint sketches and handwritten text including the words "one quarter." The colors of the drawing are primarily shades of white for the lace design and beige for the background.
title: Quilted Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
